shape.text: A Composio organization API key begins with oak_. The provider's authentication documentation and its SDK source name the prefix, and the documentation names the x-org-api-key request header that carries the key.
The body is exactly 20 characters. A dated statement by Composio's Head of Security (2026-09-17, posted on a public scanner issue) gives oak_ plus 20 nanoid characters.

The body is a URL-safe nanoid drawn from letters, digits, underscore and hyphen, so a body may begin or end with an underscore or a hyphen. The keys use an underscore-separated scheme with no checksum and no further separators.
The key has no separators and no checksum.

unresolved.reason: The statement that no checksum exists is held in a contract claim that is itself unresolved; it rests on one staff comment and no provider specification.

collisions.text: The prefix oak_ contains ak_, so a project-key reading must not match inside it; the leading boundary separates them. The four-character prefix is distinctive enough that a mixed-case check on the body is harmless but not needed.

unresolved.reason: The boundary rule is an authoring choice recorded in an unresolved contract claim, not a provider statement.
